depthFocusSignatureLaw.law: FOCUS-SIGNATURE (text on focusSignatureProof / classifyDepthShadow in scripts/check/theme/population/index.mjs): a box-shadow that is exclusively the focus signature does not declare depth; a mixture with elevation or material does; an alias whose producer does not prove its semantics stays included. Decided on the producer side, read from source on every call; no family is named by the rule. The signature root is a head channel of the catalog row states.focus-style emitted by the states derivation alone; a reset keyword is the signature's twin only where every branch of its selector is focus-gated and the same family declares the signature under a focus gate.

Aliases ambiguos permanecen conservadoramente incluidos: el nombre o fallback por sí solos no demuestran la semántica del productor. Aplicar drills positivos/negativos, medir el conjunto resultante y publicar cada entrada/salida. Mantener estados 154, umbrales, mínimos y controles. No introducir exclusiones por familia para alcanzar el porcentaje." -- translation, not the owner's text: "This message authorizes the proposed semantic correction of the depth population, not a predetermined denominator. A shadow that is exclusively a focus shadow must not declare depth. A mixture with elevation/material does. Ambiguous aliases remain conservatively included: the name or the fallback by themselves do not prove the producer's semantics. Apply positive/negative drills, measure the resulting set and publish every entry/exit. Keep states 154, thresholds, minima and controls. Do not introduce per-family exclusions to reach the percentage."

statesPopulationLaw.law: STATES-K (text verbatim on AXES.states in scripts/check/theme/population/index.mjs): a Modern skin family declares states iff K1 (a rule with a declaration whose selector branch, :not() arguments removed, carries a kernel gate -- :hover, :active, :focus, :focus-within, :focus-visible, [data-state] bare or on a token serializeState writes (disabled, hovered, pressed, focused, focus-visible), [data-disabled] bare or ='true' -- and whose gate-stripped form is not another branch of the same rule) or K2 (a head channel of a catalog states row). Retired doors: domain-valued [data-state=v], the namespaced [data-<ns>-state=] door (f8298d417), [data-active]/[aria-*]/:disabled/:checked alone, and the byStateChannel name-suffix door. No render clause (struck by Fable change 1: not computable by a CSS reader).
